newsitem.title: QATAR: Pennzoil to drill more wells in Qatar.
newsitem.headline: Pennzoil to drill more wells in Qatar.

text.p: The U.S. oil firm Pennzoil Co said on Monday it would drill three more wells in Qatar this year to search for oil and gas.

"We'll drill three more exploratory wells in September based on seismic shots we took in January this year for prospects and leads," Walter Theis, vice-president and general manager of Pennzoil-Qatar, told reporters.
Pennzoil has a production sharing agreement with the state Qatar General Petroleum Corporation to explore for and produce oil and gas from Block 8, spread over a 2,850 square km offshore.
Last year Pennzoil drilled its first well, 250 km northeast of Doha.
"But the discovery was not viable enough to start commercial operation," Theis said.
